title: Useful
subtitle: 「有用／有幫助／實用／有益／有價值」，究竟是哪一種 useful？
description: 「有用／有幫助／實用／有益／有價值」，究竟是哪一種 useful？

words.meaning: 有幫助的；能提供協助的
words.note: 使用者提供，也是 useful 最核心的近義詞之一。helpful 強調某人、建議、資訊或工具能讓事情更容易完成、理解或改善；比 useful 更直接帶『幫到你』的意味。
words.example: The guide contains several helpful tips for first-time users.

options.explanation: checklist directly made a task easier, so helpful is the most natural choice.

words.meaning: 有價值的；很有用的；值得重視的

falseSynonyms.zh: helpful 更直接表示『幫到某人』；useful 可以只表示某工具／資訊具功能價值。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The advice was helpful. This tool is useful.

falseSynonyms.zh: practical 強調能直接應用、可操作；有些 useful ideas 可能仍偏理論。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The guide gives practical advice. The theory is useful for understanding the problem.

falseSynonyms.zh: beneficial 強調正面效果／好處；useful 可以只是方便或有功能。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Exercise is beneficial to health. The checklist is useful.

falseSynonyms.zh: valuable 通常比 useful 更強，暗示資訊／經驗重要、值得珍視或具策略價值。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She gained valuable experience. The calculator is useful.

falseSynonyms.zh: effective 必須成功達到預期結果；useful 只表示有幫助，不保證完全奏效。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The treatment was effective. The leaflet was useful.

falseSynonyms.zh: worthwhile 評價整體投入是否值得；useful 可只是某一小功能有用。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The course was worthwhile. The reference table was useful.

falseSynonyms.zh: usable 只表示可以使用；useful 表示使用後有實際價值。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The old file is still usable. The file contains useful data.

falseSynonyms.zh: useful 是形容詞；usefulness 是名詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The guide is useful. We evaluated the guide's usefulness.
